summary: Implement account/role system rules: enforce unique usernames at signup and assign admin privileges exclusively to the user with username "TravvyC" (no other admins).
architectural_notes: Admin authorization is determined solely by username string equality to "TravvyC" (single-admin model).
Usernames must be globally unique; account creation must validate against existing usernames and reject duplicates.
known_issues: Newly created account did not automatically receive expected admin privileges; admin assignment rules need implementation.

existing_features.title: Update the app’s username/password auth so the ONLY admin is the account whose username is exactly "TravvyC"; no other username may ever have admin access, even if localStorage contains an old/stale `isAdmin` flag.
Enforce unique usernames during sign-up and block duplicate usernames from being created, showing a clear error in English when a duplicate is attempted.

Ensure the admin determination is applied consistently across sign-up, sign-in, and session restore (loading an existing session from localStorage) so that a previously-created "TravvyC" account becomes admin after this change without requiring manual data edits.

new_feature_requests.summary: Enforce unique usernames during account creation; reject duplicate usernames with an error
Admin role assignment: only username "TravvyC" is admin regardless of identity; no other users can be admin

projectName: Make TravvyC the only admin and enforce unique usernames at account creation
